objective: Measure the exact residual evaluator on synthetic dense and CSR structures spanning the declared maximum dimension, while recording per-case wall time and Python-managed peak allocation.

cases.expected_exact_system: All systems have x=1 and an exactly representable RHS, so completed exact evaluations have zero residual. Duplicate CSR entries cancel exactly as mathematical stored terms.

criteria.pass: All 20 cases are checkpointed; each is PASS with exact zero residual or INCONCLUSIVE with an explicit budget/limit reason. Measurements include elapsed seconds and tracemalloc peak bytes.
criteria.fail: Any unexpected exact FAIL, missing case record, non-explained INCONCLUSIVE, or lost earlier benchmark records.
criteria.interpretation: tracemalloc does not include all native allocations; runner RSS is an additional soft observation. No machine-independent runtime guarantee is claimed.
